overview_description.description:
Upsolve creates a walk-up-usable customer-facing analytics dashboard and embed it within your product in one day. This empowers your customers with deep, actionable insights directly from your existing data. But that's just the beginning. Upsolve's AI assistant then guides your end-users towards in-platform actions that significantly boost your KPIs across the board.

Rome wasn't built in a day. Your dashboard will be.

product.name: Embedded GenBI
product.description: An embedded business intelligence platform that provides customizable, real-time customer-facing analytics dashboards integrated directly into applications.

product.description: An AI-driven analytics feature that automatically interprets data, generates insights, and provides alerts to support data-driven decision-making for end users.

product.name: No-Code Dashboard Builder
product.description: A drag-and-drop interface and out-of-the-box components for building and theming interactive analytics dashboards without coding.

product.name: Seamless Data Integration via API and Connectors

product.name: Role-Based, Hyper-Personalized Dashboards
product.description: Dashboards that automatically tailor analytics content and visualizations based on the user’s role and data needs.
